# Business Rules

22 items · Status: APPROVED · GATE-02: APPROVED

_Read-only view of [business-rules.yaml](business-rules.yaml), regenerated by `tools/ba sync`. Edit the YAML, not this file._

## Summary

| ID | Name | Rule | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| [BR-001](#BR-001) | Leave date window | A leave request may cover future dates, or past dates within the current month only. A request outside this window cannot be submitted. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.1; amended by BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| [BR-002](#BR-002) | Exceeding the entitlement is reviewed, not blocked | A request that exceeds the employee's entitlement is accepted and flagged for manual review by the reviewers. It is the only policy violation that does not block submission. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §3, 4.1; amended by BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| [BR-003](#BR-003) | Seniority-based entitlement | Entitlement for some leave types, such as Paid Leave, varies by years of service according to government regulations. The system calculates it as base days plus one day per N years of service; both values are set on the leave type. The same rules apply in every country. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.1, 4.4, 4.5; amended by BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| [BR-004](#BR-004) | Gender-specific leave types | A leave type can be restricted by gender. Maternity Leave is available to female employees only. An employee cannot submit a request for a leave type they are not eligible for. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.1, 4.5; amended by BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| [BR-005](#BR-005) | Required documentation per leave type | A leave type may require the employee to upload documents defined in system settings, e.g. a hospital certificate for medical leave. A request without a required document cannot be submitted. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.5; amended by BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| [BR-006](#BR-006) | Two-step review | A leave request is first confirmed or denied by the Project Manager the employee selected, then approved or rejected by the Line Manager. Only confirmed requests reach the Line Manager. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.2; amended by BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| [BR-007](#BR-007) | Project Manager self-request is auto-confirmed | When a Project Manager submits a leave request for themselves, the confirmation step is completed automatically. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.2 |
| [BR-008](#BR-008) | Review deadline and automatic cancellation | Confirmation and approval must both be completed by the end of the calendar month of the leave start date. A request still not confirmed or approved when that month ends is cancelled automatically. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.2, 6; amended by BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| [BR-009](#BR-009) | Resubmission after denial or rejection | An employee can modify and resubmit a request that was denied by the Project Manager or rejected by the Line Manager. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.2 |
| [BR-010](#BR-010) | Off-work day definition | A working day counts as off work when no check-in time is recorded, or when total presence on that day is less than 4 hours. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.3; amended by BA decisions at and after the GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 (Q-007) |
| [BR-011](#BR-011) | Weekly attendance notification | Every Friday each employee is notified, for the last week, of the days they were absent without a leave request and the days they were absent with a valid leave request. Any submitted request counts as a valid leave request. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.3; amended by BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| [BR-012](#BR-012) | Annual entitlement refresh | Leave data is refreshed automatically at the start of each year: the system calculates every employee's entitlements for the new year. No amounts are imported. Requests still pending are then checked against the new entitlements. An entitlement does not change during the year when seniority changes. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.1, 4.4; amended by BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| [BR-013](#BR-013) | Reviewer dashboards show actionable requests by default | Project Manager and Line Manager dashboards show by default only the leave requests that require that user's action. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.7 |
| [BR-014](#BR-014) | Access by role and organisation | What a user can see and do depends on their role, and access and reporting can be scoped by country, city or office. A Line Manager sees reports for their own unit only. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.6, 4.8, 5; amended by BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| [BR-015](#BR-015) | Employee selects the confirming Project Manager | When submitting, the employee selects which Project Manager confirms the request, among the Project Managers of the projects the employee belongs to. | BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| [BR-016](#BR-016) | Cancellation by the employee | An employee can cancel their leave request as long as the Line Manager has not approved it. An approved request cannot be cancelled. | BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| [BR-017](#BR-017) | Half-day leave | Leave is requested and counted in half days. The options are All day, Morning and Afternoon. | BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| [BR-018](#BR-018) | Workflow email notifications | Submission sends an email to the selected Project Manager. Confirmation sends an email to the Line Manager. Denial, approval and rejection send an email to the employee who submitted the request. | BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| [BR-019](#BR-019) | Line Managers do not request leave | A Line Manager manages a Business Unit, not a project, and is never a Project Manager. A Line Manager does not submit leave requests. | BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| [BR-020](#BR-020) | Master data comes from the HR system | Employees, organisational units, project teams, line-manager assignments, role assignments and public holidays come from the existing HR system and are not maintained in this system. | BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| [BR-021](#BR-021) | No confirmation for an employee without a project | A request from an employee who belongs to no project has no confirmation step: the Line Manager is the only approver. | BA answer to Q-003, 2026-09-30 |
| [BR-022](#BR-022) | Working days | Weekends and public holidays are not working days. Leave is counted on working days only, and only working days can be reported as absences. | BA answer to Q-007, 2026-09-30 |
